observations.behavior: Adds exception handling and rollback when BigQuery schema discovery fails due to credential rejection.
observations.posthog_connection: Prevents a half-created warehouse source from persisting when BigQuery credentials become invalid between initial validation and schema discovery, and records the failure. This protects database consistency and user experience for warehouse ingestion workflows.

observations.behavior: Adds a unit test asserting that credential rejection during schema discovery returns a 400 status, records the expected error message, and does not persist the warehouse source.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection and documentation of the expected behavior for the credential rejection scenario.
